results.releaseNotes:
Everything since 0.9.55, in one update:

- Multiple cameras on one printer: a new switch button on the tile and the full-screen view picks which camera to show, and the choice is remembered per printer (needs plugin 0.6.22+; tiles flag printers running an older plugin)
- Compact tiles (webcam hidden) now keep the full quick-action row: pause, resume, stop and the lighting toggle right on the tile
- Tap-to-pair: opened the pairing page on this phone? Tap the link under the QR and the app pairs directly, no scanning needed
- The time-left chip now matches Mainsail estimates, averaging the same file, filament and slicer sources
- The printer page follows the dashboard onto home WiFi instead of sticking on the tunnel
- A dead or mistyped camera now says "Camera unreachable, check its address" instead of spinning forever
- Local discovery can no longer store an unusable link-local address and strand a same-network printer on the tunnel
- Direct (LAN/VPN) printers: the zero-cloud promise is now enforced in the app itself
results.description:
Moongate puts every Klipper 3D printer you own on one dashboard, at home or anywhere.

It connects straight to your own Raspberry Pi running Klipper and Moonraker. Pair once by scanning a QR code, and Moongate reaches your printer directly on your Wi-Fi, or securely over an encrypted tunnel when you are away.

No account, no email, no password. Sign-in is anonymous, and there are no ads, no analytics, and no tracking.

Features:
- One dashboard for your whole fleet, with live webcam, temperatures, and print progress
- The full Mainsail or Fluidd web interface built in
- Start, pause, and stop prints, plus a double-tap emergency stop
- Power machines on and off (smart plug or Klipper macro)
- Preheat and heat-soak from the dashboard
- Run your favourite macros
- Optional push notifications for print started, finished, and failed
- App lock with Face ID, Touch ID, or a PIN
- Custom themes, drag-to-arrange tiles, and an adjustable display size
- Back up and restore your setup
- Available in 8 languages

Moongate is free and open source. You host everything yourself, and your printers stay yours.

Note: Moongate needs the free Moongate plugin installed on your printer's Raspberry Pi. Setup guide: github.com/PEEKYPAUL/Moongate
